# AGENTS.md

This file tells an agent how to work in this repository. Read it before you change anything, and run the
tests before you propose a change. The application is small: one module and a folder of documentation.

## Boundaries

The application code is in `app.py`. Documentation is in `docs/`. Do not add dependencies without asking.

## Do Not Do

- Never edit `legacy/`: it is generated by a build that no longer exists.
- Never commit `*.bak` files or anything under `scratch/`.
